07/06/2026
Bilateral FHO Success Story 🐱
This little cat was brought to us after a traumatic accident that severely affected both hips. Due to the extent of the injuries, a bilateral Femoral Head Ostectomy (FHO) was performed.
The surgery went well, and she is now recovering comfortably. Her journey is a reminder of how resilient cats can be, even after serious injuries.
Wishing our brave little patient a smooth recovery! ❤️
dr_azhar_anwer
18/04/2026
Today with a life-saving surgery for a cat who suffered a severe injury after an accident.
Although amputation is never an easy decision, it was the best option to relieve pain and give her a chance to live a comfortable life.
Animals are incredibly resilient, and with proper care and love, they can adapt and live happily even on three legs. 🐾
Please drive carefully and always look out for animals on the road. 💔➡️❤️

نعناعه الشقيه  واقعه من الدور الرابع وكانت قاطعه اكل وشرب اكتر من يومين 💔

اتدخلنا فورا وركبنا كانيولا وعلقنا محاليل واديناها العلاج اللازم عشان نسيطر على النزيف   وبعدين بدأنا معاها كورس العلاج اللازم عشان نظبط  وضعها والحمدالله بدأت تقف على رجليها بشكل افضل🥳
الاهم من دا كله اننا قعدنا مع نعناعه وفهمناها انها قطه ماينفعش تمارس هواية الطيران وكدا عيب 😅♥️
